seo.title: About Zad Al-Muslim — Open-Source Sadaqah Jariyah
seo.description: Learn about Zad Al-Muslim’s mission, authentic Islamic texts, offline astronomical prayer math, and native lockscreen Adhan engine with zero ads.

title: Why Was Zad Al-Muslim Built?
subtitle: Zad Al-Muslim was crafted as a calm nocturnal worship sanctuary bringing together the Uthmani Quran, Azkar, offline prayer times, and reliable lockscreen Adhan — completely free of ads, tracking, and mid-prayer cutoffs.

storySection.title: Worship deserves software that respects your focus and privacy
paragraphs: Many Muslims struggle with three recurring issues in typical prayer apps: intrusive full-screen ads right before prayer, background location tracking sold to ad brokers, and Adhan audio cutting off after two seconds when the screen locks.

Zad Al-Muslim solves this from the ground up: an open-source app dedicated purely as Sadaqah Jariyah, running worship features offline on your device and using native Kotlin/Swift alarm engines so Adhan completes reliably over the lockscreen.
storySection.waqfSource: Al-Baqarah: 197 — Inspiration behind the name 'Zad Al-Muslim'

items.title: Zero Ads & Zero Trackers Forever
items.desc: No ad networks, monetization SDKs, or behavioral analytics will ever be added to Zad Al-Muslim.

items.title: Offline-First Worship
items.desc: The Holy Quran, Hadith collections, Azkar, astronomical prayer math, and Qibla compass all run locally on your device.

items.title: True Native Adhan Reliability
items.desc: We decoupled Adhan playback and lockscreen overlays from Flutter using AlarmManager and a dedicated Foreground Service.

items.title: Open-Source Transparency
items.desc: Both the mobile app and official landing site are open on GitHub for full security inspection and community contributions.

sourcesSection.title: Verified Islamic texts paired with dependable native systems
sourcesSection.subtitle: Every core feature relies on clear scholarly references and open infrastructure:

items.title: Uthmani Script Holy Quran
items.description: Crisp Amiri typography tuned for nocturnal reading with local bookmark storage; Arabic Quranic text always remains authentic across all locales.

items.title: Hadith & Hisn Al-Muslim Library
items.description: Authentic selections from Sahih Al-Bukhari, Sahih Muslim, Nawawi 40, and Riyad Al-Salihin alongside Morning & Evening Azkar with references.

items.title: Astronomical Prayer Math & Qibla
items.description: Local astronomical calculations supporting major calculation methods (Umm Al-Qura, Egyptian Survey, MWL, etc.) paired with a haptic Qibla compass.

items.title: Curated Muezzin Audio
items.description: Bundled Makkah Sanctuary, Sheikh Abdulbasit, and Sheikh Al-Afasy Adhan recordings ready to play without internet connectivity.

items.title: Nearby Mosques Finder
items.description: Uses free OpenStreetMap / Overpass map tiles strictly on-demand when you open the Nearby Mosques map, with no location history stored.

items.title: Lockscreen & Alarm Engine
items.description: Native Android AlarmClock + Foreground MediaPlayback service, with SwiftUI Lockscreen & Time-Sensitive alert support prepared for iOS.

ways.desc: Send this page to parents and loved ones looking for a clean, ad-free Adhan app that reliably rings on lockscreen.
